title: Network Participation Agreements: Shape of a Repayment Plan Down Payment by Size of Receivable
content:
A practice under the **Network Participation Agreements** may place the open overpayments of an agreement in a repayment plan by paying a down payment. The down payment base is shaped by the size of the agreement's open receivable.

**Schedule.** The down payment shape is set by the size of the open receivable:

- a receivable below 1000 USD gives a flat 250 USD, or the whole receivable when that is smaller;
- a receivable of 2000 USD or more gives 25 percent of the first 2000 USD plus 10 percent of the part above 2000 USD;
- a receivable of 1000 USD or more but below 2000 USD is not reshaped by this schedule.

## Open receivable

The open receivable is the total of the agreement's overpayment notices, less every withholding, refund and reduction booked against them. It is never taken below zero.

## Worked shapes (hypothetical receivables)

| Open receivable | Band | Down payment base |
|---|---|---|
| 180.00 USD | Below 1000 | 180.00 USD (the whole receivable, smaller than 250) |
| 640.00 USD | Below 1000 | 250.00 USD |
| 999.99 USD | Below 1000 | 250.00 USD |
| 1500.00 USD | 1000 to below 2000 | Not reshaped |
| 2000.00 USD | 2000 or more | 25 percent of 2000.00, that is 500.00 USD |
| 3460.00 USD | 2000 or more | 500.00 plus 10 percent of 1460.00, that is 646.00 USD |
